name: qwen3-235b-a22b-q3-4gpu
_comment: Qwen3-235B-A22B (235B total, 22B active MoE), unsloth UD-Q3_K_XL (96.6 GiB) across all FOUR R9700s (128 GiB). --load-mode dio required (P16, >50 GiB). NOTE: llama-bench's tensor-split separator is '/', not ',' -- '-ts 1,1,1,1' means four sweep values of '1' (everything on GPU 0) and fails with 'failed to load model'; that, not dio, was the 'llama-bench + dio + multi-GPU bug'. Measured at the 250 W power cap set by gpu-tuning.service (2026-09-30).
